dish.note: Red toffee apples on sticks, as big as the Munchkins' welcome lollipop.
dish.how: Push a stick into each apple. Boil the sugar, water, vinegar and red colouring to 150C without stirring. Tip the pan, dip and twirl each apple to coat, then stand them on baking paper to set hard.
dish.make_ahead: Make up to 6 hours ahead and keep somewhere cool and dry

steps.text: Push a stick into each apple and line a tray with baking paper.
Boil the sugar, 125ml water, vinegar and colouring to 150C without stirring.
Dip and twirl each apple to coat, then stand on the paper to set hard.
